'''Lieutenant Hereven''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] serving in the [[Galactic Scout Corps]], nearly half a century before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. When [[Milac Troper]] returned to from an unknown jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]] reporting Hereven's death, the Corps filled his death as unexplained and moved on. However, Hereven and [[Dayla Kev]], the Mission Commander of the scouting party, had been attacked by a [[gasnit]]; Troper took their ship in his panic and let them. While hiding in a subterranean cavern, Hereven and Kev fell in love. Their time together was to be short, however. Hereven was killed while out hunting, leaving a pregnant Kev to fend for herself. When she gave birth, she named her son [[Hereven Kev]], after her late lover.<ref name="GC6" />
